hooks.command: sh -c 'tmp="$(mktemp)"; trap "rm -f \"$tmp\"" EXIT; cat >"$tmp" 2>/dev/null || true; root="${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; ver="$(node -e "process.stdout.write(require(process.argv[1]).version)" "$root/.codex-plugin/plugin.json" 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -n "$ver" ]; then for f in "$root/hooks/red-fetch.mjs" "$root/dist/red-fetch.mjs" "$root/../../dist/red-fetch.mjs"; do [ -f "$f" ] && { node "$f" dev "$ver" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; node "$f" code-nav "$ver" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; break; }; done; fi; printf "{}"'

sh -c 'tmp="$(mktemp)"; trap "rm -f \"$tmp\"" EXIT; cat >"$tmp" 2>/dev/null || true; hook="${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/branch-lock-codex.sh"; if [ -x "$hook" ]; then "$hook" <"$tmp"; else printf "{}"; fi'
